## Summary
Complete implementation of PRD 110 - REST API Gateway for MCP Tools. This provides HTTP REST endpoints for all DevOps AI Toolkit capabilities, enabling integration with traditional applications and CI/CD pipelines.

## Implementation Highlights
- **Universal Tool Access**: All 9 MCP tools exposed via HTTP POST endpoints
- **Auto-Generated OpenAPI**: Dynamic OpenAPI 3.0 specification with tool schemas  
- **Zero Maintenance**: Automatically stays current when new tools are added
- **Dual Protocol Support**: REST API and MCP protocol run simultaneously
- **Production Ready**: Comprehensive documentation with real working examples

## Technical Achievements
- **Core Infrastructure**: Generic REST routing with tool registry system
- **JSON Response Transformation**: Clean JSON objects instead of MCP text format
- **OpenAPI Generation**: Complete specification with 11+ endpoints
- **API Versioning**: /api/v1/ prefix with deprecation strategy
- **Comprehensive Testing**: 100+ new test cases, 960/960 tests passing

## Documentation
- **Comprehensive User Guide**: `docs/rest-api-gateway-guide.md` with real examples
- **Kubernetes Integration**: Clear setup reference avoiding duplication
- **Dynamic Discovery**: Tool discovery patterns instead of static listings
- **Workflow Integration**: Cross-references to existing MCP guides

## PRD Status
**PRD 110: COMPLETE** ✅
- All 4 milestones delivered
- Strategic deferrals implemented (performance optimization based on usage)
- Production-ready with comprehensive documentation

## Test Coverage
- **960 tests passing** (100% pass rate)
- **100+ new REST API tests** covering all endpoints
- **Integration tests** validating MCP + REST dual protocol support
- **OpenAPI validation** ensuring specification accuracy

## Quality Standards
- All TypeScript compilation successful
- Comprehensive error handling with proper HTTP status codes
- Real working examples validated against live server
- Clean commit history with detailed implementation evidence

Closes #110
